description: PDF generation SaaS with AI-powered template creation

stories.title: Supabase Database Schema Setup
stories.description: Create all database tables in Supabase for users, API keys, templates, generations, and subscriptions
acceptance_criteria: Table 'profiles' exists with columns: id (uuid, pk), email (text), full_name (text), avatar_url (text), created_at (timestamptz), updated_at (timestamptz)

Table 'api_keys' exists with columns: id (uuid, pk), user_id (uuid, fk), name (text), key_prefix (text), key_hash (text), last_used_at (timestamptz), created_at (timestamptz), revoked_at (timestamptz)

Table 'templates' exists with columns: id (uuid, pk), user_id (uuid, fk), name (text), description (text), html (text), css (text), sample_data (jsonb), variables (jsonb), is_public (boolean), created_at (timestamptz), updated_at (timestamptz)

Table 'generations' exists with columns: id (uuid, pk), user_id (uuid, fk), api_key_id (uuid, fk), template_id (uuid, fk), input_type (text), options (jsonb), status (text), output_url (text), output_size_bytes (int), duration_ms (int), error_message (text), created_at (timestamptz), completed_at (timestamptz)

Table 'subscriptions' exists with columns: id (uuid, pk), user_id (uuid, fk unique), stripe_customer_id (text), stripe_subscription_id (text), stripe_price_id (text), plan (text), status (text), credits_used (int), credits_limit (int), current_period_start (timestamptz), current_period_end (timestamptz), created_at (timestamptz), updated_at (timestamptz)
All tables have appropriate indexes on user_id columns
RLS is enabled on all tables with policies for authenticated users to access their own data
stories.notes: Use Supabase MCP to execute SQL. Create tables in order due to foreign key dependencies.

stories.title: Supabase Auth Trigger Setup
stories.description: Create database trigger to auto-create profile and free subscription when user signs up
acceptance_criteria: Function 'handle_new_user' exists that creates a profile row when auth.users insert happens
Function also creates a subscription row with plan='free', credits_limit=50, status='active'
Trigger 'on_auth_user_created' is attached to auth.users table
New user signup creates both profile and subscription automatically
stories.notes: This ensures every user gets a profile and free tier immediately.

stories.title: API Key Management - Backend
stories.description: Create API endpoints for creating, listing, and revoking API keys
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/keys creates new API key, returns full key ONCE
GET /api/keys returns list of user's keys (prefix only, not full key)
DELETE /api/keys/[id] revokes a key (sets revoked_at)
Keys are stored as SHA-256 hash, never in plain text
Key format is pk_live_[32 random chars]
Response includes key_prefix for display (first 8 chars)
stories.notes: Use crypto.randomBytes for key generation, crypto.createHash for hashing.
